assumptions: No declared service or fixture-replayable API is involved; the agent's own web search supplies the dates, so the cases below check the report's contract and input handling, not live calendar facts.
Live qualification of whether each moment's date is this year's real date needs an explicitly authorized live case; nothing here fixture-replays that.
Static checking runs every case's inputs through the declared input_schema; cases only cover inputs that are schema-valid, since a schema-level rejection is already guaranteed by the schema itself.

Project context (reports/GROWTH_ONBOARDING_PLAN.md, wiki/INDEX.md Feature map and Code map, .agents/skills/writing-style/SKILL.md) is read when present; with no market input and no growth plan naming a buyer, the run ends with Status: needs context.
cost_drivers: One bounded Codex session on the existing pinned model pricing and spending ceiling; no managed-model routes are declared. The configured 900-second runtime ceiling is not an expected price.
Cost scales with how many candidate dates must be verified (at most 15 searches and 25 pages) and with max_moments, since each kept moment gets one draft per channel.
effects: One project.artifact write to a run-owned reports/growth/moments/<run_id>.md; no other project files change.

Reads the growth plan, wiki/INDEX.md, the writing style guide and earlier reports in reports/growth/moments/ from project state, and public web pages (calendars, notices, the business's own pricing and checkout pages) through fenced web search.
No publishing, posting, sending, emailing, scheduling, ad buying, price or code change, form submission, credential access or recursive workflow start.

cases.description: An explicit market with the default horizon and cap: the report has a run sheet, dated moment sections, a checkout readiness block and the state.
No market input: the buyer and market come from the growth plan, named on the For line, rather than being asked for or invented.
The shortest horizon with a large cap, to check that the report discloses a short list and missed channels honestly instead of padding it or rushing late channels.
The context asks to skip one moment and names one to include; the skipped moment appears only among exclusions.

inputs.context: Skip Christmas. Include the income tax return deadline if it falls in the window.
